title: Making Spaceballs the NES Game
author: Mart2d2
selftext:
Been having a lot of fun writing "Spaceballs the NES Game" for the last few months. Mostly building with GPT6 Astra, but it requires a huge amount of back and forth. The constraints of working on the NES are pretty significant given the chip came out in 1983. But Astra does a great job of working with and around these constraints, and/but aligning on values and quality has been difficult. I spend a fair amount of time coaching to better solutions and working with Astra to build great editors so that I can hand tweak music and pixels. 

The game follows along with the plot of the movie, and I've been inspired by so many great classics like Maniac Mansion and R-Type. We're up to "Chapter 1" the movie, which takes us up to Yogurt's Lair.   
  
If people like this, I'm hoping to continue through the rest of the movie. I should have enough ROM... but it's going to require a bit of squeezing!
